counter: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided transparent hand-painted cafeteria serving counter sprite. This is a narrowly scoped structural correction for an existing game, not a redesign. Preserve the existing warm honey wood, cream tile band, brushed steel food wells, painterly linework, golden lighting, front perspective, overall very wide silhouette, and EXACT positions/count/shape of all 13 empty food wells in the bottom half. Preserve the lower counter body and its dimensions. Remove the entire overhead glass sneeze guard, roof/canopy, horizontal metal beam, light reflections floating above it, and every middle vertical support. Keep ONLY the two thin end support posts at the far left and far right, rising from the countertop to near the original top edge, so separate small chalkboards can be attached later by the game. There must be completely empty real transparent space between the two end posts above the food wells so the octopus cook behind the counter is never obscured. Do not draw the cook, characters, food, text, signs, chalkboards, icons, logos, a scene background or a floor. Maintain the same wide canvas and registration: do not crop to a different camera angle or move the food wells. Fully transparent RGBA cutout, clean antialiased edges. Keep the bottom wood panel empty for separate generated name plaques.

signs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished small hand-painted cafeteria stall name sign for a warm cozy 2D game. One single horizontal sign, wide 3:1 proportions, isolated on real transparent RGBA background. Exact and only text: "面点". Render this lettering as LARGE charming hand-painted brush lettering, dark warm brown, exceptionally clear at a final display size of only 130 by 44 pixels. The letters are the main subject. Make a slim irregular cream painted wooden sign with a honey-brown wood edge, tiny worn paint details and a restrained muted terracotta accent at the corners. Include a tiny steamed dumpling as one very simple small silhouette to the LEFT of the text, no extra decorations. Warm golden afternoon lighting, gentle painterly shading, visible hand drawn outlines, appetizing old neighborhood school-canteen character. This must match an existing illustrated wooden and stainless-steel cafeteria, not introduce a new visual theme. Full sign fully visible with a modest transparent margin, straight-on view, horizontally level, no scene, no stand, no giant frame, no dark green panel, no fancy filigree, no subtitle, no numbers, no extra writing, no mascot, no whale, no trademark. Compact clean silhouette. The lettering must occupy most of the plaque height and remain distinct when reduced.
